description: Java class 'EntityQuery' providing a fluent API for building and executing entity database queries within the Apache OFBiz framework. It supports setting query parameters such as conditions, selected fields, orderings, limits, cache usage, date filtering, and more. The class facilitates executing queries in various ways, including listing results, streaming iterators, counts, and paged subsets.

classes.name: EntityQuery
classes.description: A builder class for constructing and executing entity database queries with a fluent API in Apache OFBiz.

methods.name: use
methods.description: Creates a new EntityQuery instance for a given Delegator.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Specifies the fields to retrieve in the query, replacing any existing selection.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Sets the entity or view to query against, either by name or DynamicViewEntity.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Defines the WHERE clause using conditions, field maps, or specific entities.

methods.name: having
methods.description: Sets the HAVING clause condition.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Defines ordering of results by specified fields.

methods.name: cursorForwardOnly
methods.description: Sets the result set cursor to forward-only.

methods.name: cursorScrollSensitive
methods.description: Sets the cursor to scroll-sensitive.

methods.name: cursorScrollInsensitive
methods.description: Sets the cursor to scroll-insensitive.

methods.name: fetchSize
methods.description: Sets the fetch size for the query.

methods.name: maxRows
methods.description: Limits the maximum number of rows returned.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Sets an offset (starting point) for the query results.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the set offset.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of results.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the set limit.

methods.name: distinct
methods.description: Indicates whether to filter duplicate results.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Enables or disables cache usage for the query results.

methods.name: filterByDate
methods.description: Filters results to those active during the current or specified date/time.

methods.name: queryList
methods.description: Executes the built query and returns a list of results.

methods.name: queryIterator
methods.description: Executes the query and returns an iterator over results, which must be closed when done.

methods.name: queryBatchIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator for batch processing.

methods.name: queryFirst
methods.description: Returns the first result of the query.

methods.name: queryOne
methods.description: Returns a single result, expecting only one record.

methods.name: queryCount
methods.description: Returns the count of records matching the query.

methods.name: getFieldList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of values for a specific field across results.

methods.name: queryPagedList
methods.description: Returns a paged subset of results.
